payload.prompt: Kjør lønn for Marte Ødegård (marte.degard@example.org) for denne måneden. Grunnlønn er 48650 kr. Legg til en engangsbonus på 6800 kr i tillegg til grunnlønnen. Dersom lønns-API-et ikke fungerer, kan du bruke manuelle bilag på lønnskontoer (5000-serien) for å registrere lønnskostnaden.

payload.goal: Kjør lønn for Marte Ødegård for inneværende måned med grunnlønn 48650 kr og engangsbonus 6800 kr (totalt 55450 kr). Bruk lønns-API primært, fallback til manuelle bilag på 5000-seriens lønnskontoer.
success_checks: Marte Ødegård er registrert som ansatt med e-post marte.degard@example.org
Lønnskjøring for inneværende måned er opprettet med grunnlønn 48650 kr
Engangsbonus på 6800 kr er lagt til lønnskjøringen
Total lønn 55450 kr er bokført korrekt
Bilag er opprettet og godkjent (enten via lønns-API eller manuelt bilag)
Lønnskostnad er ført på konto i 5000-serien ved manuell fallback
Motpost er ført på skyldig lønn / bankkonto
risk_notes: Lønns-API kan være utilgjengelig – manuell bilagsregistrering er planlagt som fallback
Ansatt Marte Ødegård må eksistere i systemet før lønnskjøring kan startes
E-postadressen i prompten (marte.degard@example.org) mangler 'ø' – mulig skrivefeil, bør verifiseres
Skattetrekk, arbeidsgiveravgift og andre trekk er ikke spesifisert – disse må håndteres i henhold til gjeldende skattekort
Lønnsperiode er 'denne måneden' – eksakt fra/til-dato må settes basert på dagens dato
Ingen bankkonto er spesifisert for utbetaling – må konfigureres i systemet
Engangsbonus kan ha annen skattemessig behandling enn grunnlønn – bør verifiseres
Manuell bilagsføring krever korrekt kontoplan (5000-serien) og motkontoer
payload.suggested_first_action: Søk opp ansatt Marte Ødegård via GET /employee?email=marte.degard@example.org for å bekrefte at hun eksisterer i systemet før lønnskjøring initieres.
ordered_steps: 1. GET /employee?email=marte.degard@example.org – verifiser at ansatt eksisterer, hent employeeId
2. Hvis ansatt ikke finnes: POST /employee – opprett Marte Ødegård med e-post marte.degard@example.org
3. Forsøk lønns-API: POST /salary/transaction – opprett lønnskjøring for inneværende måned med employeeId
4. Legg til grunnlønn: POST /salary/transaction/{id}/salarySpecification – beløp 48650 kr, type FIXED
5. Legg til engangsbonus: POST /salary/transaction/{id}/salarySpecification – beløp 6800 kr, type ONE_TIME_BONUS
7. FALLBACK (hvis lønns-API feiler): POST /ledger/voucher – opprett manuelt bilag
8. Fallback bilagslinjer: Debet konto 5000 (lønnskostnad) 55450 kr, Kredit konto 2910 (skyldig lønn) 55450 kr
9. Eventuelt arbeidsgiveravgift: Debet konto 5400, Kredit konto 2940 – beregn sats (14,1%)
11. Verifiser bokføring: GET /ledger/voucher/{id} – bekreft at bilag er korrekt registrert

planned_endpoints.summary: Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Create a new free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimension
Create a new value for one of the free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimensions
List salary/wage types (find Fastlønn and Bonus IDs)
Check if division exists (required for employment)
Create salary transaction with payslips and specifications

rules: Use params={"number": XXXX} to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
This is a QUERY PARAM via the params field — NOT json_body.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
AUTO-SPLIT RULES: ONLY vatType id=3 (25% utgående) triggers auto-split. vatType id=1 does NOT auto-split.
For supplier costs: use vatType=3 (NOT id=1) with ONLY the debit posting. Tripletex detects the expense account and applies inngående MVA automatically.
For vatType=0: include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': switch to vatType=3 with single debit posting, OR add both debit+credit with vatType=0.
NEVER use vatType=1 — it does NOT auto-generate balancing entries and will always cause 422 with single posting.
Do NOT include currency on postings — let it default. Including currency={} causes 'factor must be >= 1' error.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}. NEVER use account={"number": XXXX} in postings.
ALWAYS search first: GET /employee?email=<email> — the sandbox often has pre-existing employees. Reuse if found.
Only POST /employee if GET returns 0 results.
When POSTing, ALWAYS include department={"id": dept_id}. Create department first if needed.
userType should be 'NO_ACCESS' (safest default — avoids 422 errors). Only use 'STANDARD' if email login is explicitly needed.
startDate is a TOP-LEVEL field on the employee object. Do NOT put it inside an employments array.
dateOfBirth is a TOP-LEVEL field. Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
jobTitle is set via PUT /employee/{id} AFTER creation — it cannot be set in the initial POST.
Do NOT include an 'employments' array in POST /employee — employment details go via separate POST /employee/employment endpoint.

For occupation codes (STYRK/yrkeskode): POST /employee/employment first, then GET /employee/employment/occupationCode?nameAndCode=XXXX to find the code, then PUT /employee/employment/details to set it.
Each specification MUST have both 'rate' and 'count' fields. Do NOT use 'amount'.
Example specification: {salaryType: {id: fastlonn_id}, rate: 59600, count: 1}
Employee MUST have an active employment record covering the salary period.
If you get 'ikke registrert med et arbeidsforhold': create employment first via POST /employee/employment.
Employment requires a division. Create one with POST /division if none exists.
Employee MUST have dateOfBirth set before creating employment.

3. One-time bonus: 6,800 kr
4. Total: 55,450 kr
5. Period: current month (March 2026)

But the task also says: "Dersom lønns-API-et ikke fungerer, kan du bruke manuelle bilag på lønnskontoer (5000-serien)"

I have the pre-resolved accounts mapped (5000 → 378196968, 6800 → 378197069), so I'll need to update her employee record, fetch the salary type IDs for Fastlønn and Bonus, verify the division exists, and then proceed with the salary transaction.

I can run three calls in parallel since they're independent: updating the employee with dateOfBirth, fetching salary types, and checking the division. For the PUT request, I'll use the employee reference and version 2 that I already have.

I need to run payroll for Marte Ødegård. This is a salary task, so I must use POST /salary/transaction with the full prerequisite chain. Let me start by gathering prerequisites in parallel.

**Employee exists:** $REF:employee_Marte (version 2)

Let me simultaneously: set dateOfBirth, get salary types, and check for divisions.

payload.headline: Salary transaction created but 2/4 checks failed — likely salary type or amount mapping issues
what_went_wrong: Checks 3 and 4 failed — likely the salary type IDs used for Fastlønn and Bonus were incorrect or the specifications format was wrong.
The agent used $REF:account_2000 and $REF:account_2002 for salary types, but these refs suggest account IDs not salary type IDs — possible mismatch in ref resolution.
Two GET /salary/type calls were made but the actual IDs resolved may not correspond to the correct Fastlønn/Bonus salary types expected by the scorer.
The division was created with organizationNumber '999999999' (placeholder) which may have caused downstream payroll validation failures affecting the payslip checks.
what_worked: Full prerequisite chain completed successfully: employee update, division, employment, employment details all created without errors.
POST /salary/transaction succeeded (id 6959335) and checks 1 and 2 passed, confirming basic transaction structure was correct.
what_to_try_next: Verify the exact salary type IDs for 'Fastlønn' and 'Bonus/Engangsbonus' by inspecting GET /salary/type response carefully — use the correct numeric type codes, not account IDs.
Check if the scorer expects 'amount' field instead of 'rate'+'count' in salary specifications, or if a specific salaryType number (e.g., 1001 for Fastlønn) is required.
Avoid creating a division with a fake organizationNumber; check if an existing division can be reused or if the org number must match the company's actual registration.
unnecessary_calls: Second GET /salary/type call was redundant — all salary types should have been parsed from the first call's response.
GET /municipality/query could potentially be avoided if a known municipality ID is cached or pre-resolved.
GET /employee/employment/occupationCode — if a default/first occupation code is always used, this could be hardcoded to avoid the extra call.
